<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
Under standard coercivity, hemicontinuity, and strict monotonicity conditions of the flux operator $\mathbf{A}(x, \xi)$ (satisfying polynomial growth conditions dictated by exponent $\alpha$), the weak formulation admits a unique solution $\Phi \in H^1(\Omega)$.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
